metadata.title: macOS app and device data review
metadata.description: Review known macOS locations for photo, music, device backups, Xcode archives, simulators, keychains, browser and mail profiles. Most of this data cannot be regenerated.

insights.title: Review Photos library
insights.subject: photo library
insights.detail: The Photos library holds originals and edits and is a package, not a plain folder. Use Photos and its backup options; do not move or delete the package in Finder.

insights.title: Review Music media library
insights.subject: media library
insights.detail: Media files of the Music app library. Some tracks may exist only here; check Music's library and iCloud settings before any change.

insights.title: Review iPhone and iPad backups
insights.subject: device backups
insights.detail: Local backups of iOS devices, often many gigabytes, and possibly the only copy of device data. Manage them with Finder's Manage Backups window.

insights.title: Review Xcode archives
insights.subject: build archives
insights.detail: Archives hold the dSYM symbols needed to symbolicate crash reports for builds you shipped. Keep archives for released builds; Xcode's Organizer lists them.

insights.title: Review iOS simulator devices
insights.subject: simulator data
insights.detail: Simulated device data, including app containers and test state. Use Xcode or xcrun simctl to review and remove devices rather than deleting folders by hand.

insights.title: Review Docker Desktop data
insights.subject: VM disk
insights.detail: Docker Desktop's virtual machine disk with images, containers and volumes. Volumes can hold database data. Use Docker's settings or docker commands; do not edit the disk image.

insights.title: Review Keychains
insights.subject: keychain
insights.detail: Keychain databases hold passwords, certificates and keys. Do not copy, move or delete these files by hand; use Keychain Access and its backup tools.

insights.title: Review Firefox profiles
insights.subject: browser profile
insights.detail: Profiles hold bookmarks, saved logins, extensions and sessions. Use Firefox's clear-data settings for cache; export what you need before removing a profile.

insights.title: Review Chrome user data
insights.subject: browser profile
insights.detail: Profiles hold bookmarks, saved passwords, extensions and history. Use Chrome's Delete browsing data for cache, and check sync before removing a profile.

insights.title: Review Signal messages
insights.subject: message store
insights.detail: Encrypted message database and attachments. Signal cannot restore messages without this data. Use Signal's backup and export options before any change.

insights.title: Review Thunderbird profiles
insights.subject: mail profile
insights.detail: Mail, address books and account settings. Local folders can hold mail that exists nowhere else. Back up the profile before any change.

insights.title: Review DaVinci Resolve database
insights.subject: project database
insights.detail: Project database, settings and caches for DaVinci Resolve. Projects may be stored here. Use the Resolve project manager and its backup options.

insights.title: Review Ableton user library
insights.subject: user library
insights.detail: Presets, samples and devices you saved or installed. Items saved here are not restored when Live is reinstalled. Back up before any change.

insights.title: Review Zoom local recordings
insights.subject: recordings
insights.detail: Local meeting recordings saved by Zoom, often the only copy. Move them to backup storage before changing anything.
